# Naviamp v2.6.0 — Android TV and Naviamp Connect beta

Naviamp 2.6.0 brings your music to Android TV and Google TV and introduces Naviamp Connect for
controlling playback between Android and desktop devices on your local network. **Android TV and
Naviamp Connect are beta features:** they are ready to try, with further device, recovery, and
performance testing still underway.

## Highlights

- Browse and play music on Android TV with a remote, using the same Android app as your phone or tablet.
- Pair Naviamp devices to control playback, transfer a queue, and set up a device from an existing connection.
- Choose whether Naviamp keeps the screen awake while it is open.

## Features

- **Android TV and Google TV (beta):** a television interface for browsing your library, searching,
  viewing albums and artists, managing the queue, changing settings, and enjoying Now Playing with
  remote-control navigation. Connect directly to a supported music source or optionally set up the
  TV from another Naviamp device. One Android package automatically chooses the phone, tablet, or
  TV interface. ([Issue #17](https://github.com/goosepod/naviamp/issues/17),
  [issue #82](https://github.com/goosepod/naviamp/issues/82),
  [PR #84](https://github.com/goosepod/naviamp/pull/84))
- **Naviamp Connect (beta):** discover and securely pair Android and desktop devices on the same
  local network, choose a playback device, control playback, and transfer queues. Trusted devices
  can reconnect, and an existing connection can be offered to set up another device. TV acts as a
  playback target; phones and desktops can control or receive playback.
  ([Issue #17](https://github.com/goosepod/naviamp/issues/17),
  [PR #84](https://github.com/goosepod/naviamp/pull/84))

## Improvements

- Add a keep-screen-awake preference on supported devices, preserved through settings export,
  import, and sync. ([Issue #17](https://github.com/goosepod/naviamp/issues/17),
  [PR #84](https://github.com/goosepod/naviamp/pull/84))

## Bug fixes

- Improve playback recovery after audio interruptions and keep interrupted live radio streams
  available to retry. ([Issue #17](https://github.com/goosepod/naviamp/issues/17),
  [PR #84](https://github.com/goosepod/naviamp/pull/84))

## Upgrade notes

- Existing v2.x installations can upgrade in place. No special upgrade steps are required.
- Install the same Android APK on phones, tablets, and Android TV. An Android App Bundle is also
  included for distribution tooling; this release does not launch Naviamp on Google Play.
- Update both ends of a Connect session to this release. Connect currently supports Android and
  desktop clients; iOS Connect integration and ongoing automatic cross-device settings/activity
  synchronization are not included.

## Known issues

- **Android TV and Naviamp Connect remain beta.** Core playback and bounded phone/Mac LAN checks
  have passed, but the broader device/network recovery matrix and a watched physical-device
  audio/render performance pass remain incomplete. Please report problems with the device models,
  app versions, and steps to reproduce them.
- Connect requires reachable devices on the local network; this is not an internet relay or
  Chromecast/AirPlay integration.
- The iOS artifact remains an unsigned preview. Windows and macOS packages are not publisher-signed
  and may show operating-system warnings.
